## Certification & testing support
- https://ropureoem.com/certification.html
- Tell us your target market and model, and we will confirm the exact certificate list for that model before you order.
- EU: CE-LVD, CE-EMC, RoHS, REACH — available for selected models.
- UK: UKCA-LVD, UKCA-EMC — available for selected models.
- Other markets: confirmed per model on enquiry.
- Certificates are confirmed per model and brand. No certificate is promised for a model until confirmed.
